subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram slash sessions still resolve to channel=(unknown), causing elevated allowFrom checks to fail on 2026.3.13

question: Which canonical fix shape should OpenClaw use for Telegram slash-session channel identity in elevated `allowFrom` diagnostics?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the repair changes channel identity used by elevated authorization and there are already two linked open candidate PRs with different approaches.

options.title: Adopt one sandbox-explain repair
options.body: Choose or rebase one existing candidate, or land a maintainer-owned equivalent, with regression coverage and redacted Telegram proof.

options.title: Document agent-scoped keys only
options.body: If bare `telegram:slash:*` keys are intentionally obsolete, document the current agent-scoped diagnostic key shape and close the candidate PRs after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Adopt one sandbox-explain repair
recommendation.body: Choose or rebase one existing candidate, or land a maintainer-owned equivalent, with regression coverage and redacted Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is recent ownership of session metadata and sandbox diagnostic behavior.
